declined.text: keep VBW 1 support working (the existing agent-override behavior and its tests stay green) alongside VBW 2

requirements.text: make measure counts CMM vs Read/Grep/Glob calls inside VBW 2 workflow agents (from workflow subagent transcripts) and does not score those runs as enforcement bypasses
ctx-execute-enforcer allows Bash from vbw:* agents and bare vbw CLI calls, while still blocking the main thread, other agents, and compound vbw commands
setup.sh detects VBW 2 separately from VBW 1 and reports its version
No stack gate (session-gate, grep-cmm-gate, cmm-nudge, agent-cmm-gate) leaves a vbw:* agent without a permitted route
A VBW 2 agent can run CMM queries (search_graph, trace_path, get_code_snippet, search_code) within its tool allowlist and get results
All 7 VBW 2 agent types get CMM-first code-search guidance they can act on with their allowed tools

CONTRIBUTING.md and CLAUDE.md document the VBW 2 + /qa-cycle PR sequence: feature/* branch off develop before the first VBW step, a GitHub issue mirroring the requirements as the QA contract, push and PR to develop from the main session (VBW never pushes), /qa-cycle rounds with their own fix commits, keep-the-changes then vbw prove, accept, ship
The PR to develop is approved through /qa-cycle (clean round, GitHub issue as contract), and every QA fix commit is kept and re-proven by VBW
VBW 2 mapping scouts get codebase structure from CMM, and .vbw/map.md points later agents to the live CMM graph

todos.text: Generate .vbw/map.md directly from CMM (get_architecture) so VBW 2 skips its own mapping on large repos
Field-test the VBW 2 stack: install it, run VBW 2 on a large repo with many sub-projects, collect make measure before/after CMM vs Read/Grep/Glob counts

decisions.text: vbw:* enforcement posture: Redirect (grep-cmm-gate blocks code Grep from vbw:* and names the exact codebase-memory-mcp cli command; fails open when CLI missing or repo unindexed; Read stays advisory)
decisions.why: Same rules as main thread and R4 holds; accepts a turn per blocked Grep and that Bash rg still bypasses

decisions.text: CMM CLI access for vbw:* agents: setup.sh installs a wrapper command that enforces a read-tool allowlist plus index_repository, resolves the project from cwd and adds --quiet; agents may index when the project is missing; SessionStart keeps kicking off indexing (existing hook-driven indexing on develop)
decisions.why: User's choice: shorter agent commands and one place for project lookup, works on never-indexed repos; accepts one more installed file that can drift from CMM CLI flags and agents writing graphs
